result.note: Tests the statute and section being amended for UPI pricing, and that P2P payments stay fee-free while any MDR is limited to merchants.

questions.prompt: In August 2026, the Ministry of Finance clarified the proposed framework for charges on Unified Payments Interface (UPI) transactions. Consider the following statements:
items: The proposed changes amend Section 10A of the Payment and Settlement Systems Act.
Under the proposed framework, peer-to-peer UPI payments will attract a nominal, threshold-based fee.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explain: Everyday consumer and P2P payments will face zero transaction fees. Any future Merchant Discount Rate will be nominal, threshold-based and limited to a select subset of merchant transactions. The ministry said the Section 10A amendments aim at UPI's long-term technological sustainability, cybersecurity and infrastructure expansion.
questions.source: Under the proposed framework, everyday consumer and P2P payments will face zero transaction fees
